CURRENT QUESTION:
how much more money was given out in 2024 than in 2023, in percent terms
attempts.response:
```sql
WITH yearly_disbursements AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN "Disbursement Date" LIKE '%2023%' THEN 2023
      WHEN "Disbursement Date" LIKE '%2024%' THEN 2024
    END AS year,
    SUM("Loan Amount (Rs)") AS total_amount
  FROM shg_loan_register
  WHERE "Disbursement Date" LIKE '%2023%' OR "Disbursement Date" LIKE '%2024%'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  ((MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2024 THEN total_amount END) - MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2023 THEN total_amount END)) / NULLIF(MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2023 THEN total_amount END), 0)) * 100
FROM yearly_disbursements;
```
